title: Oil Rich Japanese Pork Tonkotsu Ramen
description: A buttery and fluffy Japanese ramen dish featuring vegetable shortening and a tagine-cook method, low in fat and wrapped in ti leaves. This romantic Tohoku-inspired dish is perfect for a special occasion.

ingredients.name: pork bones
ingredients.notes: you can also use pork neck bones or rib bones

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the vegetable shortening over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the pork bones and tagine spice blend, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the mixture for 2 hours, or until the meat is tender and the broth is rich and creamy.
